Level 2

Intermediate

Python. 10 to 12 weeks, one session a week.

Thonny, Python 3.10+ standard library only (turtle, random, time, files). pytest (installed once via Thonny's package manager) from week 8.

0 of 12 weeks done on this device

Weekly lessons

  1. 1

    Week 1: Welcome Back, Python

    Every value has a type, and f-strings glue values into friendly messages.

    Done
  2. 2

    Week 2: Functions That Give Back

    return hands an answer back; parameters make one function work for many jobs.

    Done
  3. 3

    Week 3: Lists: Collections of Things

    A list keeps many values in order, and the first one is number 0.

    Done
  4. 4

    Week 4: While Loops and Game Loops

    A while loop repeats until something changes, and every game is a loop.

    Done
  5. 5

    Week 5: Dictionaries and Secret Codes

    A dictionary looks things up by name, not by number, and can even hold a secret code.

    Done
  6. 6

    Week 6: Review and Checkpoint

    Bugs are normal: detectives find them with a strategy, not by luck.

    Done
  7. 7

    Week 7: Files: Saving Your Stuff

    A program forgets everything when it closes, unless it writes things down in a file.

    Done
  8. 8

    Week 8: Testing: Prove It Works

    A test is a tiny program that checks your program, so bugs get caught before players find them.

    Done
  9. 9

    Week 9: Event-Driven Games

    Keys and timers make things happen; a game loop moves the world one frame at a time.

    Done
  10. 10

    Week 10: Project Studio 1

    Plan first, then build the core: a small program that works beats a big one that does not.

    Done
  11. 11

    Week 11: Project Studio 2

    Tests check the brain of your program, playtesters check the fun, and polish makes it work for everyone.

    Done
  12. 12

    Week 12: Showcase and Celebration

    Share what you built, explain how it works, and see how far you have come.

    Done

Final project: Arcade Game or Art Studio

Choose: (a) an arcade game in turtle with keys + timer + score, or (b) a generative art studio that saves/loads designs. Must use: functions with parameters/returns, a list, a dictionary, a while or game loop/timer, a file (high scores or saved art), and at least 3 pytest tests of their own functions.
